material.acceptance_criteria: ci.yml wasm-pack build lines producing site/pkg for browser, browser-reconnect and page-self-reload carry --no-opt; other args unchanged; no other job, Rust or page file changed. Witness: ci-status for the pushed sha shows browser-reconnect, browser and page-self-reload success and no failure.
material.description: Browser-job wasm build failed on 4a635fa (run 38931630489) with wasm-opt exit 1 in browser-reconnect at 'Export the map image and build the wasm module into the page'. Fix is --no-opt on the wasm-pack build lines that produce site/pkg. Only .github/workflows/ci.yml.
material.subject: ci.yml: pass --no-opt to every wasm-pack build of the served page
material.witness: ci-status f8ab064 (run 39078459366/39078459424): browser page probes success incl. reconnect, self-reload, map; --no-opt opt-out removed deliberately (75dbfcf, 92b8d695); row acceptance text superseded by that decision. Witness-log line appended.
